run_make_unicode_casefold_main: run the main function to generate C++ Unicode case folding tables for RE2
run_Delta_function: run the Delta function to compute the delta between two Unicode codepoints handling even odd parity
run_AddDelta_function: run the AddDelta function to add a delta value to a Unicode codepoint
run_MakeRanges_function: run the MakeRanges function to compress Unicode codepoint pairs into compact ranges with deltas
review_make_unicode_casefold_script: review the make_unicode_casefold script that generates C++ case folding and tolower tables for RE2
